noOrg.body: Saba umuyobozi w'urubuga gushyiraho umwanya wawe wa <mono>organization</mono>. Iyo bimaze gushyirwaho, abakoresha bose bahuriye kuri icyo kigo bazagaragara hano.

orgMembers.confirmDeactivate: Guhagarika {{name}}? Bazahita batakaza uburenganzira ako kanya.

modal.title: Ongeraho umunyamuryango

modal.roleNote: Ibigo bigizwe n'abanyamakuru. Abaturage ni konti zigenga; uruhare rwa Media House n'urwa Admin rushyirwaho n'umuyobozi w'urubuga.
modal.passwordNote: Bisangize n'umukoresha. Bashobora kubihindura nyuma yo kwinjira bwa mbere.
